root_cause.text: The `dev_fwd_path` function in `net/core/dev.c` triggers a kernel warning (`WARN_ON_ONCE`) when the forwarding path stack depth exceeds `NET_DEVICE_PATH_STACK_MAX`, which can be reached through legitimate userspace configurations such as nesting multiple IPIP tunnels.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff removes the `WARN_ON_ONCE` macro from the boundary check `if (WARN_ON_ONCE(k >= NET_DEVICE_PATH_STACK_MAX))` in `net/core/dev.c`, and the commit message states that "recent support for IPIP tunnels increases chances of reaching this WARN_ON_ONCE if userspace manages to build a sufficiently long forward path."
